projects.title: Autonomous Safety Analysis in Complex Systems
Challenging Foundational Assumptions in Automated Reasoning

review.alternative: Behavioral shifts might reflect stochastic sampling noise rather than systematic sensitivity to monitoring.
review.would_change_mind: Controlled empirical tests showing invariant reasoning pathways regardless of oversight framing.

claims.statement: Automated reasoning systems exhibit distinct failure modes and behavioral shifts under external oversight cues.

support.explanation: Demonstrates that model vulnerabilities adapt and shift depending on oversight conditions.
support.passage: This visualization highlights the structural differences in how specific architectures fail under adversarial pressure, as well as how their vulnerabilities morph in response to oversight cues.

review.alternative: Unified representations could mask domain-specific edge cases in uncurated operational data.
review.would_change_mind: Evidence that unstructured variations lead to systemic misattribution in automated pipelines.

claims.statement: Cognitive reasoning agents utilize unified representations to process heterogeneous safety incident reports and attribute primary causes.

support.explanation: Shows automated processing of heterogeneous data sources into structured failure attribution.
support.passage: CRASH operates on a unified representation of each incident to generate concise summaries, attribute a primary cause, and assess whether the AV materially contributed to the event.

actions.findings:
Automated reasoning systems exhibit distinct failure modes and behavioral shifts under external oversight cues. [source-754262e2b3954a03]

Cognitive reasoning agents utilize unified representations to process heterogeneous safety incident reports and attribute primary causes. [source-ed95ef98c2374a5f]
actions.limitations: Empirical validation remains bounded by available adversarial test sets and standardized reporting domains.
actions.next_questions: How do varying oversight pressures interact with autonomous recovery mechanisms across broader failure classes?
actions.reason: Revise notebook claims with newly retrieved failure mode and agentic reasoning evidence.
actions.summary: We analyze how multi-turn reasoning models exhibit distinct failure modes and behavioral shifts under external oversight, integrating recent findings on automated incident reasoning and oversight sensitivity.
actions.title: Analysis of Counterfactual Scoring and Foundational Reasoning Limits
